title: 第1章 君子报仇从不隔夜第2章 末世筹划
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 【ps:世界背景是平行架空世界，剧情内容纯属虚构，请勿带入现实！！】
【各位帅气美丽的看官别急，後面越来越精彩。】
“林羽，林羽……”
一阵呼喊如回声般由远及近，声音慢慢大了起来，眼前的景象也由朦胧，逐渐清晰。
林羽看着眼前包间里面。
一个个熟悉而又陌生的脸庞，混乱的记忆如潮水涌来，涨得他脑袋发昏，半晌才回过神来。
“林羽，别磨蹭了，还不快给班长敬酒，讨好一下，你们公司那个项目就妥了。”
这时，一个声音传入耳中。
林羽扭头望去，一个西装革履的青年笑着催促。
他是吴然，班长的狗腿子。
“我想起来了。”
熟悉的场景，熟悉的话语，在十年前自己就经历过了。
这是大学毕业后，第一年的同学聚会。
青年口中的班长，父母是市里一家上市公司的老板，妥妥的富二代。
因为他喜欢的女人，成了自己的女朋友，没少被他找麻烦。
林羽收回目光，端起桌上的酒一饮而尽。
“这味道，真是怀念啊……”十年末世，自己已经记不得这种纯正的味道了。
重生了！他回到了末世爆发前。
林羽只有一瞬间的惊讶，更多的是惊喜。
重生了，他终於有机会去改变一切，去弥补前世的遗憾，去成就最强。
林羽掏出手机，解锁屏幕。
一张熟悉的面孔映入眼帘。
手机屏保上，一个如阳光明媚般的女孩，下巴枕在他的头顶，双手绕前捏着他的脸颊，哈哈笑着。
惬意而温馨。
“小幽，这一世，哥哥一定会找到你，保护好你，一定！”
林羽目光扫过手机屏幕最上方。
还有半天，到了今晚15号凌晨，末世将会降临。
恐怖的尸潮，无数的变异，将会给这个世界带来恐惧，杀戮和黑暗。
“林羽，怎麽？出了校园还认不清现实？信不信我一个电话，就让你从你们公司滚蛋！”
坐在对面的寸头青年，见林羽无视了所有人，顿时脸色阴沉了下来。
林羽面前，酒水洒落开来，飞溅到了他的衣服上。
狗腿子吴然突然抬手，打翻了他的酒杯。
他指着林羽就要口吐芬芳：“林羽，你特么……”
然而，他话还未说完。
林羽便蓦地起身，一手拉过他的脑袋，重重的砸在了桌子上。
顿时，酒菜乱飞。
杀猪般的惨叫声响起。

[ps: The world background is a parallel fictional world, the plot content is purely fictional, please do not bring it into reality! ! 】
[Handsome and beautiful readers, don’t worry, it will get more and more exciting from now on. 】
"Lin Yu, Lin Yu..."
A burst of shouting came from far and near like an echo, the sound gradually became louder, and the scene in front of me gradually became clear from hazy.
Lin Yu looked inside the private room in front of him.
Familiar yet unfamiliar faces, and chaotic memories came flooding in, making his head dizzy, and it took him a long time to come back to his senses.
"Lin Yu, stop dragging your feet. Why don't you toast to the squad leader and please him? Your company's project will be finished."
At this time, a voice came into my ears.
Lin Yu turned around and saw a young man in a suit and leather shoes urging him with a smile.
He is Wu Ran, the monitor's lackey.
"I remembered."
Familiar scenes and familiar words were experienced by me ten years ago.
This is the first-year class reunion after graduating from college.
The squad leader in the mouth of young people, his parents are the bosses of a listed company in the city, and they are the second generation of rich people.
Because the woman he liked became his girlfriend, he often caused trouble for her.
Lin Yu withdrew his gaze, picked up the wine on the table and drank it all.
"This taste, I really miss it..." At the end of ten years, I can no longer remember this pure taste.
Reborn! He returned to before the apocalypse broke out.
Lin Yu was only surprised for a moment, but more of a surprise.
After being reborn, he finally had the opportunity to change everything, to make up for the regrets of his previous life, and to become the strongest.
Lin Yu took out his phone and unlocked the screen.
A familiar face came into view.
On the phone's screen saver, there was a girl who looked as bright as the sun, her chin resting on the top of his head, her hands coming around to pinch his cheeks, laughing.
Cozy and warm.
"Xiaoyou, in this life, my brother will definitely find you and protect you, for sure!"
Lin Yu glanced at the top of the phone screen.
June 14, 2080.
There is still half a day, and in the early morning of tonight, the 15th, the end of the world will come.
The terrifying zombie tide and countless mutations will bring fear, killing and darkness to this world.
"Lin Yu, what's the matter? You can't recognize the reality after leaving campus? Believe it or not, I will tell you to get out of your company with just one phone call!"
The short-haired young man sitting opposite saw Lin Yu ignoring everyone, and his face suddenly darkened.
"Bang..."
In front of Lin Yu, the wine spilled and splashed on his clothes.
The loser Wu Ran suddenly raised his hand and knocked over his wine glass.
He pointed at Lin Yu and began to spit out fragrance: "Lin Yu, what the hell are you..."
However, he hasn't finished speaking yet.
Lin Yu stood up suddenly, pulled his head with one hand, and slammed it on the table.
Suddenly, food and wine were flying everywhere.
"Ah!"
A scream like a slaughtering pig rang out.
